title: Satyajit Ray
summary: Satyajit Ray (1921–1992) was a Bengali filmmaker and writer whose Apu Trilogy, starting with Pather Panchali (1955), brought Indian cinema global acclaim. He also created the detective Feluda and scientist Professor Shonku.
